/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.descriptionZh: 杀死 |COUNT| 个飞行的低语者敌人
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: We shall not stand idly by while The Murmur hurls violence on us from above. Take out their airborne units.

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: Murmur Sarcophages, stockpiles for their creeping takeover of Papa's Laboratories. Raid the Sarcophages, leave those things nothing of value.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourZh: 低语者石棺，是它们悄悄控制爸爸实验室的储藏点。洗劫这些石棺，不留下任何有价值的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/Challenge_EntratiLabNearConduitVulnerabilityChallenge_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.descriptionZh: 爆破型殁世机甲在距离导管 40 米以外处于无敌状态
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: Be wary, the Papa's advanced security protocols have been triggered. Necramech Demolishers will be invulnerable until 40m from their target Conduit.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourZh: 请小心，爸爸的高级安全协议已被触发。爆破型殁世机甲在距离导管 40 米以外是不会受到伤害的。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/Challenge_EntratiLabRangedMechWeakpointChallenge_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.descriptionZh: 摧毁 |COUNT| 个重型炮兵的弱点
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: The Rogue Culverin. A formidable fighter of Papa’s own design; yet I have seen its schematics and I believe it has several vulnerabilities. Test my theory, locate its weak points and destroy them.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourZh: 暴戾重型炮兵。爸爸自己设计的一个强大战士；但我看过它的设计图，我认为它有几个弱点。验证下我的理论，找出它的弱点并摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: Get in. Get out. No time for lollygagging. Speed is of the essence.

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: Find a terminal and deploy your personal Necramech. Perhaps your shining example will teach manners to those rogue marauders out in the labs.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourZh: 找到一台终端机并部署你自己的殁世机甲。也许你的光辉榜样能教会实验室里那些暴戾掠夺者什么是礼仪。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.descriptionZh: 文卷将于 20 秒后消失
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourEn: The Paranoia Protocol; Papa's Dockets disappear after lying on the ground for 20 consecutive seconds. Do not delay.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/EntratiLab/Entra.flavourZh: 疑虑协议：爸爸的文卷在地面上放置满 20 秒后会消失。不要拖延。

Whatever you are doing out there. It is working.

Your loyal Cephalon,
Ordis

您忠诚的中枢，
Ordis
